To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose a novel algorithmic and theoretical framework for designing and analysing model-based RL algorithms, (2) we show that the framework extends the optimism in face of uncertainty principle to nonlinear dynamical models, and (3) we demonstrate that instantiating the framework with simplification yields a variant of modelbased RL algorithms that outperforms the current state-of-the-art when only one million samples are permitted on continuous control benchmark tasks.
